name: Samantha Vanders
source:
Bex's live-in girlfriend and a police officer working for the Vesper City Police Department, Sam ironically met Bex on a donut run for her police buddies. Sam is a strong woman who enjoys showing men she is stronger than them but will gladly bend to one powerful enough to control her.
